address: 7F, Four Seasons Hotel Tokyo at Marunouchi, 1-11-1 Marunouchi, Chiyoda-ku, Tokyo, 100-6277, Japan
bio: Casual French dining overseen by Chef Daniel Calvert of SÉZANNE. Both prix fixe and à la carte offerings are served at lunch as well as dinner, so guests are spoiled for choice. Everyday bistro fare such as chicken-liver pâté, confit of pork belly and beef steak are raised to the height of elegance. Floor-to-ceiling windows afford sweeping views of the shinkansen bullet trains passing through Tokyo Station and the office towers of Marunouchi....
